verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs claim a modern 3D renderer with lights, shadows, materials, glTF loading, custom shaders, materials and render pipelines, and contact shadows added in 0.19. That covers the renderer core and the shadows part of the story. Community reports of jagged, low-res shadows and visible aliasing in an earlier release point to quality limits rather than a missing capability. Missing for 10: explicit PBR material documentation, global illumination or baked lighting, post-processing effects (e.g., anti-aliasing, bloom, tonemapping), and independent hands-on corroboration of production-grade visual quality.
